answer: The ocean I would price into every new account is Allotted airport manager accreditation with airport operators attestation: an accreditation operators renew after terminal audits, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. The economics flip: the network spends pennies verifying, the attacker spends real money proving, and the summit of that gap is the whole defence in one line. Time is the tax here: an accreditation operators renew after terminal audits cannot be rushed or parallelised beyond a point, so the hollow for a farm is a calendar it cannot buy its way out of.
